_notes.bench_ctx: the families' long-standing bench standard per box: an untested model runs at it
_notes.champion: priced at every knob, never auto-stopped: its price list is the point (34-Hard-Bench-Order-Spec, 34-CHARTER section 10)
_notes.crown: the agentic lead's crown: a decision about the box, not a measured row (menu_policy writes it into the policy's roles)
_notes.fill_order: the order the filler tops boxes up in; boxes not listed follow by name
_notes.offload_ok: models allowed to run partly in system RAM on this box (the owner's ruling): their windows declare --offload-ok
_notes.prelim_champion: models priced at every knob before their crown is final
_notes.shape: the box's hard-bench shape (S6 = an 8 GB card, S7 = the lead)
_notes.tablet_classes: the Fellowship tablets' hardware classes (A, B, C), for the chat family's reduction
_notes.tested_ctx: Every value: the spill-aware fit probe on ollama 0.40.5 with LLAMA_ARG_FIT_TARGET=512 (campaigns\fit-20261015; BigHonker's desktop-aware re-fit fit-20261019-desktop, qwen3-vl:8b fit-20261023). qwen3.6:35b-a3b is absent: it spills into shared memory at every context down to 1,024 on Mothership, so it has no tested context. The small models (nemotron-3-nano:4b, minicpm-v:4.6-q4km, minicpm5:1b-q4km) fit at their full windows on the 8 GB boxes.
_notes.tier: the placement tier each box homes (menu_policy tiers)
_notes.tiers: homes: the design's tiers and their home boxes; overflow: the other tiers' boxes a tier spills to, in order
_notes.unceiled: a box whose families are priced with no time ceiling

crown.why: Phase 2 reopened by the RAM swap and CLOSED 2026-10-18 (register): A1 lead role 12/15 vs the 3.8's 9/15 on one harness, a superset of its solves, ~0.58 vs ~0.94 MJ whole-box per solve; blind quality parity (Claude + external Codex review). Crown SHARED by job family: this is the agentic lead; the 3.8 (crowned 2026-10-09: 8/9 + 3/7 hard) keeps the quick families. The owner: 'trust your judgment'
